_meta.name: canvas
_meta.note: The canvas projection is the only projection permitted to be lossy. It may collapse execution-tree coordinates for painting, but the canonical event remains authoritative.
_meta.lossy_note: Canvas collapses execution-tree coordinates for painting. The trace projection is the only other lossy projection, and its loss is deliberate curation: user-facing traces show WHAT happened, never orchestration internals (owner ruling 2026-07-13).

connection.event_received.drop_reason: Provider payloads do not paint until admission produces trigger.fired.

email.received.drop_reason: Email content does not paint until admission produces trigger.fired.

conversation.reply_received.drop_reason: Conversation content does not paint until admission produces trigger.fired.

memory.record_changed.note: Metadata-only memory mutation paints as background agent activity.

storage.object_uploaded.note: Metadata-only resource upload paints as background agent activity.

trigger.fire_requested.drop_reason: A request paints no child run until admission produces trigger.fired.

trigger.skipped.drop_reason: A skipped trigger starts no run; it is not a canvas paint step.

trigger.failed.drop_reason: A failed trigger starts no run; failure details stay in the trigger plane.

trigger.disabled.drop_reason: Trigger enable/disable is admin lifecycle, not a canvas paint step.

trigger.enabled.drop_reason: Trigger enable/disable is admin lifecycle, not a canvas paint step.

tool_event.note: Legacy tool_event paints as a completed tool dispatch.

interrupt_request.drop_reason: No canvas vocabulary value exists for a pending interrupt.

interrupt_required.drop_reason: No canvas vocabulary value exists for an interrupt-required marker.

model_routing.drop_reason: Model routing is a trace-curated decision record, not a canvas paint step.

assignment_received.note: Assignment receipt paints as agent activity.

assignment_completed.note: Assignment completion paints as an agent response.

model_tool_complete.note: v1 only emits after completion; v2 also emits pre-dispatch tool selection separately.

heartbeat.drop_reason: Connection health is not part of the seven canvas events.

update.note: Generic updates paint as active agent reasoning.

progress_update.note: Streaming progress paints as active agent reasoning.

status_message.note: Standalone status messages paint as active agent reasoning.

status_message_chunk.note: Status message chunks paint as active agent reasoning.

final.note: Final v1 event completes the canvas run.

error.note: Canvas has no failure event; error details stay in payload.

system_tool_start.note: System tool start paints as dispatch start.

system_tool_chunk.drop_reason: Incremental system tool chunks do not change the seven-event canvas state.

system_tool_complete.note: System tool completion paints as dispatch completion.

system_tool_error.note: Canvas has no tool failure event; failure details stay in payload.

hook_fired.drop_reason: Hook callbacks are internal instrumentation, not a canvas paint step.
